Membership and event tickets, how does it work?
Your ₹999 membership gives you access to MET's curated community and the opportunity to participate in eligible events throughout your membership period.
Individual event tickets are purchased separately.
Each ticket covers that particular experience, such as the venue, food and activities included in the event.
Event tickets typically cost ₹2,999–₹3,499 each, depending on the experience.
How do you join?
Pay ₹999
Complete your introductory membership payment.
Complete your screening on WhatsApp
We'll send you the screening questions so MET can review your application.
Get approved and join MET
If approved, your membership is activated and you receive community access.
Not approved? Your full ₹999 is refunded.
What happens after 3 months?
If you enjoy being part of MET and want to continue, you can choose to purchase a new annual membership for ₹8,999 (12 months).
There's no automatic renewal.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I attend MET events on my own?
Yes! You don't need to bring a friend. You can attend on your own and meet new people through the experience.
Why does MET screen applicants after payment?
MET is a curated, friendship-focused community. Every application is reviewed before community access is approved. If MET doesn't approve your application, your full ₹999 is refunded.
What if an event I want to attend is fully booked?
Places at individual events are subject to availability. Membership does not guarantee a place at every event.
